select asic.id, asic.rule_id, asic.type, asic.link_id, asic.reason, asic.start_at, asic.end_at, asic.utime, asic.state, ar.alert_name as rule_name
,i.name as link_name
,p.name as link_name
,m.name as link_name
,concat(aa.sn," : ",aa.host) as link_name
,concat(a.sn," : ",e.host) as link_name
,(case asic.type when 'asset' then concat (aa.sn,':',aa.`host`) when 'endpoint' then concat (a.sn,':',e.host) when 'project' then p.name when 'module' then m.name when 'datacenter' then i.name end) as link_name
from alert_silence_conf asic left join alert_rule ar on asic.rule_id = ar.id left join endpoint e on asic.link_id = e.id left join asset a on e.asset_id = a.id left join project p on asic.link_id=p.id left join module m on asic.link_id=m.id left join asset aa on asic.link_id = aa.id left join dc i on asic.link_id=i.id where 1=1
and asic.id = #{params.id}
and asic.state = #{params.state}
and asic.start_at >= #{params.startAt}
and asic.end_at <= #{params.endAt}
and i.name like concat('%', #{params.query}, '%')
and p.name like concat('%', #{params.query}, '%')
and m.name like concat('%', #{params.query}, '%')
and (aa.host like concat('%', #{params.query}, '%') or aa.sn like concat('%', #{params.query}, '%'))
and (e.host like concat('%', #{params.query}, '%') or a.host like concat('%', #{params.query}, '%') or a.sn like concat('%', #{params.query}, '%'))
and asic.type = #{params.type}
mapper.update: UPDATE alert_silence_conf SET state = ( CASE WHEN now() < start_at THEN 1 WHEN ( now() >= start_at AND now() <= end_at ) THEN 2 ELSE 3 END);
